info.prompt: Cyberpunk alchemist's lab meets high-stakes digital casino: {translucent bone-white|obsidian black|gilded iron} UI panels shaped like cathedral arches house a glowing Farkle grid, every tile a faceted gemstone die suspended in {liquid gold|mercury silver|plasma blue} energy fields, Stone Blockers crackling with granite fissures, Wild tiles emitting rainbow corona bursts, the background a depth-blurred neural network of {crimson|emerald|violet} synaptic connections fading into infinite darkness.
